title: Ring sectionwise construction and operation compatibility
statement:
{C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C) :
    (∃ (F : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max u v w} ⥤ CommRingObjCat (Sheaf J (Type (max u v w))))
        (G : CommRingObjCat (Sheaf J (Type (max u v w))) ⥤ Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max u v w})
        (hF : F ⋙ CommRingObjCat.forget _ = sheafCompose J (forget CommRingCat.{max u v w})),
      G ⋙ sheafCompose J (forget CommRingCat.{max u v w}) = CommRingObjCat.forget _ ∧
      F ⋙ G = 𝟭 (Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max u v w}) ∧
      G ⋙ F = 𝟭 (CommRingObjCat (Sheaf J (Type (max u v w)))) ∧
      (∀ (A : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max u v w}) (U : Cᵒᵖ),
        (∀ a b : (F.obj A).X.obj.obj U,
          ((eqToIso hF).hom.app A).hom.app U ((AddMonObj.add (X := (F.obj A).X)).hom.app U (a, b)) =
            (show A.obj.obj U from ((eqToIso hF).hom.app A).hom.app U a) +
              (show A.obj.obj U from ((eqToIso hF).hom.app A).hom.app U b)) ∧
        (∀ t : (𝟙_ (Sheaf J (Type (max u v w)))).obj.obj U,
          ((eqToIso hF).hom.app A).hom.app U ((AddMonObj.zero (X := (F.obj A).X)).hom.app U t) =
            (0 : A.obj.obj U)) ∧
        (∀ a : (F.obj A).X.obj.obj U,
          ((eqToIso hF).hom.app A).hom.app U ((AddGrpObj.neg (X := (F.obj A).X)).hom.app U a) =
            -(show A.obj.obj U from ((eqToIso hF).hom.app A).hom.app U a)) ∧
        (∀ a b : (F.obj A).X.obj.obj U,
          ((eqToIso hF).hom.app A).hom.app U ((MonObj.mul (X := (F.obj A).X)).hom.app U (a, b)) =
            (show A.obj.obj U from ((eqToIso hF).hom.app A).hom.app U a) *
              (show A.obj.obj U from ((eqToIso hF).hom.app A).hom.app U b)) ∧
        (∀ t : (𝟙_ (Sheaf J (Type (max u v w)))).obj.obj U,
          ((eqToIso hF).hom.app A).hom.app U ((MonObj.one (X := (F.obj A).X)).hom.app U t) =
            (1 : A.obj.obj U))))

proof.text: Construct ringStructure by the five sectionwise operations. Naturality is map_zero, map_add, map_neg, map_one, map_mul. Check every internal ring diagram pointwise using the commutative-ring identities on sections. Define the forward functor on the unchanged underlying sheaf and maps; homomorphisms preserve the four ring-hom operations.

Prove fullness: given an internal ring morphism, evaluate its zero_hom, add_hom, one_hom, mul_hom equalities on sections and package the underlying functions as CommRingCat.ofHom. Naturality is the original naturality equation. Faithfulness follows by composition with the faithful forgetful sheaf functor.
Apply the object-reconstruction theorem to the explicit forward functor; its section formulas are definitional equalities. This gives bijectivity on objects.

Use Mathlib CategoryTheory.Functor.asIsomorphism (Mathlib/CategoryTheory/IsoCat.lean, lines 132-141) for the full, faithful, object-bijective functor. Its strict inverse gives both round-trip equalities. Associativity of composition, hF and the inverse-forward equality imply the inverse forgetting equality. Assemble these with the five already verified section formulas.

proof_origin.note: Explicit sectionwise forward construction and fullness; object reconstruction split off; strict inverse from Mathlib IsoCat.
